category: uptime monitoring, incidents and status pages (hosted in the European Union)

free_tier.stated: Hobby plan, free and with no credit card: 100,000 monitoring events a month with no additional usage, unlimited projects, organization users and public status pages with custom domains and SSL, and 10 AI incident summaries a month; no SMS or voice alerts and no single sign-on
free_tier.notes: The unit is the monitoring event; how many monitors 100,000 events cover depends on the monitoring strategy, and the Scale plan row relates its included events to about 5 monitors. The vocabulary has no events term, so requests is the nearest. Hobby events cannot go past the allowance: it is marked No additional usage.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a monitor checks a target; nothing is stored per object

retention.stated: unverified: no retention period is stated on the pricing page

egress.terms: not applicable: an outbound checker; monitor data is read back through the API

interface_detail: An API for most tasks available in the control panel, with organization-scoped or project-scoped API keys created by an Owner or Admin and per-product scopes of no access, read-only or read-write.
tooling: the web control panel and any HTTP client with an API key; outgoing webhooks to build SMS or voice alerts
chaining: External monitoring with unlimited projects and alerts on 100,000 events a month, public status pages on custom domains with SSL, and webhooks to chain alerts into other services.

limits.value: 100,000 monitoring events per month with no additional usage
10 AI incident summaries and postmortems per month

limits_note: Hobby has no SMS or voice alerts and no single sign-on.
binding_note: The 100,000 monitoring events a month cap how many monitors can run at a short interval; the event allowance cannot be raised on Hobby.

identity_cost.detail: The pricing page describes the Hobby plan as for people with no credit card; the sign-up form asks for an organization name, a work email address and a password with a confirmation, behind a not-a-robot check.

reliability_note: no throttle, ban or data loss is stated on the pages read; what happens when the 100,000 events are used up is unverified: not stated on the pricing page beyond No additional usage
confidence_note: Plan limits are quoted from the first-party pricing page, the API access from its documentation and the sign-up fields from the sign-up page. No account was opened.
